[SWS_DM_02015] Reporting security access denied to IdsM
⌈
In case a diagnostic service request is not allowed in the current security level, which
results in a negative response with NRC 0x33 (securityAccessDenied), the DM shall
report a security event SEV_UDS_SECURITY_ACCESS_NEEDED to IdsM (see [13]
and table [SWS_DM_02016]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02016].
⌋
